title: CDP Command Guide: Full Reference
desc: CDP full reference: cdp-mon anomaly codes, bug history, PS5.1 gotchas, tab accumulation, caller HWND, placement. Load when investigating anomalies.
steps: cdp-mon ANOMALY REPORT: [CRIT] offscreen TGT-POS x<-100 / LAT=DEAD / JS-alert / MEM>2GB. [WARN] sessions>5 / tabs>6 / drift>200px / lat>80ms / age>10h / MEM>1GB / dups>2. [INFO] CWD unknown.

cdp-mon LAUNCHED-BY (3-tier chain): (1) alive parent PID -- walk up process chain until wkappbot-core.exe found, parse cmdline for subcmd. (2) dead parent -- glob HQ/logs/wkappbot-core.exe.out-*.CMD.pid=PID.log; filename encodes command so no log read needed. (3) Chrome URL fallback -- extract hostname from active tab URL (gemini.google.com -> ask gemini, chatgpt.com -> ask gpt). PS5.1 gotcha: switch -Wildcard incompatible with scriptblock cases -- use if/elseif chain instead.

cdp-mon JS ALERT detection: Get-TabIdle connects WebSocket (200ms timeout); if connect OK but Runtime.evaluate times out (300ms) -> Alert=true. JS alerts block all CDP eval -- tab shows LAT=ALERT. Post-command alerts NOT detected; only stale alerts blocking at poll time caught. Fix: wkappbot cdp eval GRAP 'window.onbeforeunload=null' to clear blocking handlers.

cdp-mon IME DAEMON: Watch-ImeDaemon counts *ime-relay-daemon* processes; if 2+ found, auto-kills oldest by StartTime (unless -nofix). Root cause: HasRealImeContext(WT hwnd) returning true on CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS (ConPTY) because ImmGetContext returns non-null even though IME non-functional. Fix (commit 139cf6fb): check UnicodeWindowClasses BEFORE ImmGetContext.

cdp-mon PS5.1 GOTCHAS: (1) localhost resolves to IPv6 on Win11 but Chrome CDP binds 127.0.0.1 only -- always use http://127.0.0.1:PORT/json with Host:localhost header. (2) switch -Wildcard incompatible with scriptblock cases -- use if/elseif chain. (3) null-coalescing ?? unavailable in PS5.1 -- use if/else. (4) Nullable struct .Value.L fails -- PS unwraps nullable, use .L directly.

TAB ACCUMULATION BUG (gemini-whisper, fixed fe65cbf0): WhisperStudy passing --target-tag {engine}-whisper to EnsureCdpConnection caused sandbox-miss on wrong Chrome (HTS port 9712 vs project port). Fix: removed --target-tag arg -- EnsureCdpConnection URL-matches existing Gemini tab by host. Symptom: cdp-tab-growth.jsonl shows gemini-whisper sandbox-miss-create on unexpected port.

CALLER HWND DETECTION: Launcher walks ancestor PID chain via NtQueryInformationProcess PROCESS_BASIC_INFORMATION.InheritedFromUniqueProcessId (64-bit offset=40). If chain shows [{pid:8}] only, binary predates offset-40 fix (was 24=BasePriority=8). Fix: SDK commit d69b080b (2026-05-24). Full powershell->claude->wkchat ancestry resolves HWND to nearest terminal/IDE window.

TAB-ACCUMULATION FIX (2026-05-25): web/cdp open reuse path closes dead tabs. In WebCommands.Part3.cs tab-reuse probe: (1) close chrome-error:// tabs via Target.closeTarget before matching, (2) skip chrome-error:// URLs in hit-search, (3) ping matched tab with EvalAsync timeout 2000ms; if unresponsive, close and create fresh tab. NEVER kill Chrome process -- only individual tabs.

PLACEMENT-PREFLIGHT (v7.4.0): MyCdpContext.PlacementValidate.cs fast-path before 5x150ms retry loop -- reads current Chrome rect once (no sleep), compares to target, returns immediately if within=True. Eliminates ~750ms wait. Log: [PLACEMENT:VALIDATE] preflight delta=(dX=N,...) within=True -> skip loop.

ROOT CAUSE cdp open >1min: KillStaleChromesAsync calls GetCommandLineWithStatus per chrome proc (N x 2500ms = 62s with 25 procs). FIX: BatchGetChromeCmdLines() ONE wmic call for all chrome.exe (4s max) in ChromeLauncher.Timeout.cs. Fix committed Core 2026-05-31.

CRLF-EDIT-BUG: wkappbot file edit multiline --old with CRLF files silently fails (shell passes LF but file has CRLF, match fails). Single-line edits work. For CLAUDE.md Pending, use wkcodex.sh or single-line replacements only.

LOCK-FIX: to clear skill-update-pending, chain skill-edit + git-add-skillfile + git-commit in ONE Bash call. PostToolUse fires after the full chain sees clean diff and does not re-create lock. Separate calls fail: PostToolUse re-creates lock between calls when skill JSON is modified.

BUG (2026-05-25) cdp open spawns new Chrome even when existing Chrome alive: IsPortActiveAsync fails for renderer-crashed Chrome -> reusePort=0 -> new launch. Fix: (1) zombie tab cleanup + liveness ping in WebCommands.Part3.cs, (2) last-resort process scan before new launch. Root: need process-cmdline fallback when HTTP probe fails.
SESSION-2026-05-25: Chrome reuse CI test written to scripts/test-cdp-reuse.ps1 + .github/workflows/cdp-reuse.yml. Key: second cdp open must show Reusing Chrome on port X, not Launching Chrome.
